title: A flaw was found in Keycloak. An authenticated remote user with a pending required security action, such as…
description: A vulnerability in Keycloak allows an authenticated user with a pending required security action, such as setting up multi-factor authentication, to bypass this mandatory action. By submitting a specially crafted request to the consent endpoint without a valid session code, Keycloak treats the request as a page refresh and completes authentication improperly. This flaw enables the user to access the application without fulfilling the required security policies.
